# Link

`ui.link` · parts: `Link` · elements: `<a>`

## Purpose

Link renders a semantic anchor for navigation. Use Button for actions.

## Notes

<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:start -->
_No additional notes for Link yet._
<!-- ui8kit-docs:prose:end -->

Link renders an anchor; External opens a new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer.

## Props

| Canonical (templ, Jinja2) | React / Solid | HTML (Svelte, Vue, WC) | Type | Default | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Href` | `href` | `href` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `Target` | `target` | `target` | `string` | — | prop | explicit target; External implies _blank |
| `Rel` | `rel` | `rel` | `string` | — | prop | explicit rel; External defaults to noopener noreferrer |
| `External` | `external` | `external` | `boolean` | — | prop | opens in a new tab with safe rel defaults |
| `Download` | `download` | `download` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaCurrent` | `aria-current` | `aria-current` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |
| `AriaLabel` | `aria-label` | `aria-label` | `string` | — | passthrough attr |  |

Also accepts: `class` (`className` in React), extra attributes (rest props in UI frameworks, `Attrs` in templ/Jinja2, `attrs` in Twig/Latte; caller wins), children.

## Variants

_No variants: the primitive ships no visual classes; style it with token classes via `class`._

## Children

Accepts children (default slot / `children` / `{ children... }` / trusted HTML string in Twig, Latte, Jinja2 — see [runtimes](../runtimes/)). Void tags selected via `tag` render no children.

## ARIA

- Computed/forwarded: `aria-current`, `aria-label` (omitted when empty).
- Typed ARIA props: `aria-current`, `aria-label` — static values only.

## Classes escape hatch

Compose the part's classes without rendering it (custom root element, no asChild outside React):

| Runtime | Helper |
| --- | --- |
| React / Solid / Vue / Svelte / WC | `linkClasses({ ... })` from `link/link.shared.ts` |
| templ | `link.LinkClasses(link.LinkProps{...})` |
| Twig | `ui8kit_classes('linkClasses', { class: '…' })` |
| Latte | `\UI8Kit\Latte\Classes::linkClasses(['class' => '…'])` |
| Jinja2 | `link_classes(p)` |

## Rendered DOM per state

Canonical renderer output (children = `Content`); all 9 runtimes are parity-tested to produce this DOM.

| State | Props | HTML |
| --- | --- | --- |
| defaults | — | `<a>Content</a>` |
| basic | `{"Href":"/a"}` | `<a href="/a">Content</a>` |
| external | `{"Href":"https://e.com","External":true}` | `<a href="https://e.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Content</a>` |
| explicit | `{"Href":"/b","Target":"_self","Rel":"nofollow"}` | `<a href="/b" target="_self" rel="nofollow">Content</a>` |
| blank | `{"Href":"/c","Target":"_blank"}` | `<a href="/c" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Content</a>` |
| current | `{"Href":"/d","AriaCurrent":"page","Download":"f.txt"}` | `<a href="/d" download="f.txt" aria-current="page">Content</a>` |
| External | `{"External":true}` | `<a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Content</a>` |

## Usage

Fixture `basic` (`{"Href":"/a"}`) — every snippet renders:

```html
<a href="/a">Content</a>
```

**React** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/react.md))

```tsx
import { Link } from "./ui/link/link";

<Link href="/a">Content</Link>
```

**Vue 3** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/vue.md))

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import Link from "./ui/link/Link.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Link href="/a">Content</Link>
</template>
```

**Svelte 5** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/svelte.md))

```svelte
<script lang="ts">
  import Link from "./ui/link/Link.svelte";
</script>

<Link href="/a">Content</Link>
```

**SolidJS** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/solid.md))

```tsx
import { Link } from "./ui/link/link.solid";

<Link href="/a">Content</Link>
```

**Web Components** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/webcomponent.md))

```ts
import { renderLink } from "./ui/link/link.wc";

document.body.append(renderLink({ href: "/a" }, "Content"));
```

**Go templ** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/templ.md))

```templ
import "github.com/ui8kit/codegen/generated/templ/ui/link"

@link.Link(link.LinkProps{Href: "/a"}) {
	Content
}
```

**Twig** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/twig.md))

```twig
{% include 'link/Link.html.twig' with { href: '/a', children: 'Content' } only %}
```

**Latte** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/latte.md))

```latte
{include 'link/Link.latte', href: '/a', children: 'Content'}
```

**Jinja2** ([runtime notes](../runtimes/jinja2.md))

```jinja
{% with p = {'Href': '/a'}, children = 'Content' %}{% include 'ui/link/link.html.j2' %}{% endwith %}
```
